ROLE: Append the 7-bits-per-byte Remaining Length encoding of value (private).

SIGNATURE.RAW: static int wire_write_remaining_length(struct byte_buf *out, size_t value)
SIGNATURE.NAME: wire_write_remaining_length

STRUCT.NAME: struct byte_buf
STRUCT.ROLE: destination buffer whose cap must already cover the encoded field

FUNC.NAME: buffer_append
FUNC.ROLE: append each encoded byte after the capacity reservation

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: buffer_append
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: int buffer_append(struct byte_buf *buf, const void *src, size_t len)
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 0 when all len bytes were appended in order; -1 when nothing was appended
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: src is borrowed for the duration of the call only
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: -1 leaves the buffer contents unchanged; the caller returns -1 and the packet is not emitted

LOGIC.INPUT: out (the packet buffer being built) and value in 0..268435455.
LOGIC.ACTION: 1) If out is NULL return -1. 2) If value > 268435455 return -1 (the encoding cannot express it; a longer field is malformed, fact F004). 3) Encode into a 4-byte stack array: repeated do { b = value % 128; value /= 128; if (value > 0) b |= 0x80; field[i++] = b; } while (value > 0) so the low 7 bits come first and the continuation bit 0x80 marks 'more bytes follow'. 4) Append the i bytes in order with buffer_append (i is 1..4); buffer_append itself guarantees all-or-nothing behaviour, so an allocation failure returns -1 with the output unchanged. 5) Return 0. Encoders call this after reserving the whole packet size, so the append cannot reallocate; the worst case is therefore reported as a generic failure.
LOGIC.OUTPUT: 0 when the 1..4 byte field was appended; the buffer length grew by exactly i. -1 when out is NULL, value exceeds 268435455, or the append failed; in every -1 case no byte was appended.
INVARIANTS_USED: the low 7 bits of the value are transmitted first
the high bit of every byte except the last is 1
standard encoding never uses more than 4 bytes for a legal value
LOGIC.PRECONDITION: out is NULL or a valid buffer.
LOGIC.POSTCONDITION: On success buffer[len-i .. len-1] is the field and the rest of the buffer is untouched.
LOGIC.THREAD_SAFETY: Not thread safe; the caller owns the buffer.

WIRE_MAPPING.RULE: 7 bits per byte, least significant group first; each byte except the last sets 0x80. 127 -> 7F (1 byte); 128 -> 80 01 (2 bytes); 16383 -> FF 7F (2 bytes); 16384 -> 80 80 01 (3 bytes); 268435455 -> FF FF FF 7F (4 bytes).
